segs.t: Từ vt. của yellow, magenta, cyan, black.
Scandinavian giant god: in Norse mythology, the forefather of all the giants.
Ymir was killed by Odin và his brothers, và the world was formed from his body, the sky from his skull, và the water from his blood.
variation of Xmodem file transfer: a variation of the Xmodem file transfer protocol in which data is sent in 1-kilobyte blocks
